Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional teams. Experience with mobile testing frameworks, automation, and CI/CD pipelines is a strong advantage. title: Motor Control Strategy
jobDescription: Motor Control Strategy Engineering | Full-Time | Pune About the Role Bajaj Auto Technology is looking for an Engineer with hands-on expertise in motor control algorithm design and embedded implementation for EV traction applications. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and refining advanced motor control algorithms — from concept through deployment on real hardware. You will work closely with the lead engineering team to deliver robust, performance-optimised control software for PMSM/BLDC/SynRM-based EV drivetrains, while contributing to continuous improvement of our development methodology and toolchain. Key Responsibilities Algorithm Design & Development: Design and develop motor control algorithms (FOC, MTPA, Field Weakening, torque/speed control) for motors used in EV traction applications. Build model-based control algorithm designs using MATLAB/Simulink (or equivalent) with emphasis on simulation fidelity and traceability. Develop and validate observer/estimator algorithms (e.g., flux observers, position sensorless algorithms) and tune dynamic behaviour for target drive cycles. Implement thermal management strategies and derating logic to ensure safe operation across the full operating envelope. Embedded Implementation & Validation: Implement control algorithms on microcontroller platforms using embedded C & own the full cycle from model to embedded code. Conduct Vehicle and motor dynamometer testing to verify and validate algorithm performance against specifications. Perform systematic calibration and parameter tuning to optimise dynamic response, efficiency, and NVH characteristics. Debug, profile, and optimise embedded code for timing constraints, memory footprint, and execution determinism. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Coordinate with cross-functional teams (hardware, system engineering, vehicle integration, etc.) to align motor control deliverables with system-level requirements. Benchmark algorithm performance against industry standards; identify gaps and propose actionable improvement initiatives. Stay current with developments in motor control, power electronics, and EV technology; bring relevant insights and innovation ideas to the team. Required Competencies Technical / Functional: Proven hands-on experience with FOC algorithm design including current control loop tuning, MTPA trajectory generation, and field weakening control. Proficiency in model-based design environments: MATLAB, Simulink, Stateflow and auto-code generation workflows (Embedded Coder, TargetLink, or equivalent). Working knowledge of C/C++ programming for embedded targets; ability to read, write, and review production-quality embedded code. Experience with DSP/microcontroller-based motor drive platforms; familiarity with ADC, PWM, encoder/resolver interfaces. Familiarity with automotive architecture, product development stages and MCU architecture. Knowledge of automotive product development processes and role of motor control integration within an EV development. Behavioural: Strong ownership mindset — delivers commitments reliably and escalates risks early. Structured analytical approach to root-cause analysis and problem-solving under time pressure. Effective communicator; able to present technical findings clearly to both peers and stakeholders. Self-driven learner with an appetite to master new tools, methods, and domain knowledge independently.

title: Requirements Engineer - Connected Applications
jobDescription: Requirements Engineer – Connected Applications (Mobile & Cloud, Wi-Fi/BLE, IoT) Role Description The Requirements Engineer – Connected Applications will own end-to-end requirements definition for connected vehicle and IoT features spanning in-vehicle systems, mobile applications (Android/iOS), and cloud platforms . The role ensures requirements are clear, testable, user-centric, and traceable , with a strong focus on mobile app interactions with vehicles/devices and cloud services over Wi-Fi, BLE, and other wireless technologies . Key Responsibilities Mobile Application & Connected Features Define and refine user stories, functional flows, and UX-impacting requirements for customer-facing mobile applications (Android/iOS) interacting with vehicles/IoT devices and cloud backends. Specify BLE/Wi-Fi–based pairing, provisioning, and connectivity flows , including reconnection scenarios, error handling, and security constraints. Collaborate closely with mobile product owners, UI/UX designers, and app developers to translate use cases into detailed app-level requirements (navigation, screen behavior, notifications, permissions, localization). Define API and data-contract expectations between mobile apps and cloud/vehicle services, including request/response formats, error codes, latency expectations, and offline/online behavior. Capture non-functional requirements for mobile applications, including performance (startup time, responsiveness), battery usage, data consumption, and reliability under varying network conditions. Ensure requirements address platform-specific considerations (Android/iOS guidelines, OS version support, device compatibility, and baseline accessibility expectations). Support backlog grooming, release planning, and prioritization by clarifying requirements, dependencies, and acceptance criteria for mobile and connected features. Qualifications & Experience Experience working with Android and/or iOS application teams in defining and managing requirements or user stories for connected, IoT, or automotive applications . Working understanding of mobile app architectures (client-server, MVVM/MVC at a conceptual level), push notifications, and app-store release constraints is desirable. Skills & Competencies Strong end-user and app-centric mindset , with the ability to translate real-world journeys into intuitive, implementable mobile requirements. Comfortable discussing flows, wireframes, and acceptance criteria with UX and mobile development teams while maintaining rigorous requirements structure and traceability. Ability to balance product intent, technical feasibility, and user experience in a connected ecosystem.

title: Edge Developer
jobDescription: Position: Firmware Engineer – Telematics Experience Level: 5 – 8 years. Location: Pune Desired Qualification: BE/ BTech/ ME/ M.Sc./ Mtech in Electronics (& Telecommunication)/ Instrumentation/ Controls/ Electrical Engineering/ Computer Science from a reputed institute. Job Description: Join our Telematics Engineering team to lead the development and optimization of the Vehicle Network Interface. You will be the bridge between the vehicle’s edge-level implementation and the cloud, managing the critical firmware that powers Analytics, Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates, and Remote Diagnostics. This is a high-impact role where you will not only maintain current systems but also architect the connectivity solutions of the future. Required Exposure: Understanding of overall IOT frameworks from security and data communication standpoints. Understanding of MQTT protocol, TCP/IP and UDP. Knowledge of security implementation using certificates in PKI environment. Hands – on exposure to CAN-FD, UART and SPI drivers Hands – on exposure to UDS and ISO-TP protocols. Preferred add-ons: Working experience with Renesas RH850 microcontroller using GreenHills/ CS+ compiler and E2 debugger using C/ C++. Experience with Doxygen for document generation. Scripting skills (Perl/Python/VB) would be an added advantage. Core Responsibilities System Ownership: Manage the microcontroller-based firmware that interfaces between the vehicle network and the cellular modem. Feature Implementation: Drive the edge-level logic for critical telematics functions, including OTA Flashing, remote diagnostics, and data analytics. Root Cause Analysis: Lead cross-functional troubleshooting to determine if issues originate in the Cloud, Network Interface, or Vehicle Interface, and coordinate resolutions. Connectivity Optimization: Partner with stakeholders to refine device provisioning and optimize network traffic to ensure a robust, high-performance connection. Architecture Evolution: Identify design improvements and participate in shaping the next-generation connectivity architecture for future vehicle platforms. Problem Solver: Ability to analyze complex system logs to debug intermittent connectivity issues in a distributed cloud-to-vehicle ecosystem. Collaborative Mindset: Experience working with cloud engineers and system architects to optimize end-to-end data flow.

jobDescription: Position: Embedded Software Integration engineer Experience Level: 4 - 10 years. Exposure to CAN based networks. Understanding of RTOS concepts. At least 3 years of experience in Matlab, Simulink and Stateflow. Sound understanding of auto-code generation using embedded coder. Familiarity with software configuration management tools (SVN/GIT), defect tracking tools, and peer review Preferred add-ons: Exposure to AutoSAR based design philosophy. Experience in Functional testing on hardware. Familiarity with any scripting language python/Perl/ C#. Understanding of how ECU software participates to ensure overall vehicle operation. Understanding of control strategies for electrical machines/ battery management Exposure to CMMi/ ASPICE practices Exposure to automotive data acquisition tools from vector, intrepid etc. Exposure to ECU calibration and measurement using INCA. Job profile: The selected candidate shall work closely with the hardware development team to configure BAL proprietary architecture on a given ECU based on application need. While doing so, he/ she may need to decompose the application requirement into multiple functional blocks interfaced with each other. This would involve partitioning the functional requirement into implementation blocks, defining interfaces for each block, and analytically deriving priority of execution for each block. Subsequent to this, the function development, i.e. implementation of each block, may be handled by a separate function development team who needs to be supported by the selected candidate. Such support may include creation of low-level code packaged into S functions to improve CPU utilization or development of certain re-usable modules. Thus, he/ she may need to support incorporation of specific S-functions into the Matlab – Simulink development environment used for function development. In addition, the selected candidate shall support basic validation and configure the build tool-chain before handover to function development group. During function development, the selected candidate shall provide support for architecture and debug of vehicle level issues. He/she shall aid root cause analysis of vehicle issues. The selected candidate shall also be responsible for creating release software for ECU based on inputs from test & validation group and function development. Therefore, he/ she needs to collaborate closely with function development, and test and verification groups. title: Electrical Battery Integration
jobDescription: Job Title: Electrical Battery Integration Engineer Role Overview: Lead the electrical design and integration of high-voltage (HV) battery packs and systems for next-generation electric vehicles. Ensure electrical safety, performance, reliability, and compliance with automotive and global standards. Collaborate cross-functionally on the seamless integration of battery packs from prototype to production. Key Responsibilities: • Own the development, analysis, and integration of battery electrical architectures, including high-voltage (HV) and low-voltage (LV) domains, busbars, harness, connectors, and current sensing solutions. • Develop integration strategies for Battery Management Systems (BMS) hardware: including voltage, current, temperature monitoring, cell balancing, isolation, and diagnostics. • Ensure all electrical interfaces—HV, LV, data/signal—are robust, reliable, and manufacturable. • Validate electrical design against safety standards (AIS, ISO, IEC, UL); coordinate EMI/EMC and functional safety (ISO 26262) compliance. • Lead prototype builds, testing, and commissioning of integrated battery systems; resolve issues in HV design, relay, fuse selection, interlocks, grounding, and insulation resistance. • Optimize electrical layouts for cost, manufacturability, efficiency, and system-level integration. • Oversee cable/harness design, connector selection, and electrical safety measures for crash, thermal, and environmental requirements (water/dust ingress, vibration). • Support integration of control strategies: CAN, LIN, FlexRay communication, interface with vehicle control units (VCU), and diagnostics platforms. • Maintain detailed documentation: electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interface specifications, FMEA, test reports, compliance submission. • Benchmark competitor solutions; drive innovation and improvements based on the latest technologies, regulations, and industry best practices. • Guide next-generation development efforts and troubleshoot escalated integration issues during product engineering, validation, and launch phases. • Mentor junior electrical engineers; provide expertise on compliance, architecture, and hands-on hardware debug. Qualifications: • Bachelor’s/Master’s in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field. • 3+ years proven experience in automotive or EV battery system electrical design and integration. • Proficiency in ECAD tools (Altium, Capital, EPLAN, Zuken), circuit simulation, and data analysis. • Strong understanding of cell chemistry, HV/LV architecture, power electronics, and BMS. • Experience in validation and integration of battery packs with real-world vehicle systems. • Familiar with global automotive integration and safety standards (ISO, AIS, UL). Profile Standouts: • Excellent troubleshooting and system-level integration abilities. • Passion for automotive electrification and safe, innovative battery system deployment. • Strong communication skills and cross-functional team experience

title: Charging Infra
jobDescription: Overview We are seeking an experienced Electronics Hardware Design Engineer with deep expertise in the design and development of power electronics for EV charging infrastructure. This role is dedicated solely to the development of high-performance hardware solutions-from schematic design and component selection to PCB layout and integration of power conversion modules. The successful candidate will focus on the creation of innovative, scalable designs, ensuring optimal performance and efficiency for next-generation charging infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Circuit Design & Schematic Development: Develop detailed schematics for high-power charging systems, including AC/DC and DC/DC converters, pre-charge circuits, and protection circuitry. Design circuits incorporating high-voltage components, such as power MOSFETs (Silicon, SiC, GaN) diodes, and snubber networks for transient suppression. Create isolation circuits using opto-isolators and isolation transformers to ensure safe power conversion. PCB Layout & Component Integration: Translate complex schematics into optimized PCB layouts, addressing high-current traces, controlled impedance, and thermal management. Integrate key components including high-power converters, switching regulators, EMI filters, inductors, and capacitor banks into cohesive designs. Incorporate microcontrollers, FPGAs, or dedicated power management ICs to implement digital control schemes and smart charging algorithms. Advanced Power Electronics Design: Engineer high-efficiency switching regulators and power conversion circuits using simulation tools (e.g., SIMetrix, SPICE, MATLAB/Simulink) to predict circuit behavior under varying loads. Develop precise voltage regulation, over-voltage, and under-voltage protection mechanisms, along with current limiting and thermal shutdown features. Design and optimize EMI/EMC mitigation strategies, including layout techniques, passive filtering, and shielding for robust performance in electrically noisy environments. Component Specification & Integration: Select and qualify critical components (capacitors, resistors, semiconductors) ensuring adherence to electrical and thermal ratings, reliability, and cost constraints. Develop power distribution architectures that include advanced converters, rectifiers, and isolation modules tailored for rapid charging applications. Design Documentation & Collaboration: Produce comprehensive design documentation including schematics, layout files, and component specifications for review and integration into system-level designs. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (mechanical design, firmware, system architecture) to ensure seamless integration of the hardware design into the overall charging solution. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in high-power electronics design with a strong focus on power conversion and charging systems. Proven expertise in designing high-voltage power electronics including switching regulators, converters, and isolation circuits. Proficiency in using circuit design and simulation tools (e.g., Altium Designer, SIMetrix, OrCAD, SPICE, MATLAB/Simulink) for rigorous design validation. In-depth knowledge of PCB layout techniques for high-current and high-voltage applications, including thermal and EMI management. Desirable Attributes Prior experience in developing charging infrastructure for EVs or renewable energy applications. Familiarity with digital control implementation using microcontrollers or FPGAs in power management systems. Ability to innovate and drive the design of complex hardware systems from concept through detailed design documentation. Strong problem-solving skills and a detail-oriented mindset, with a focus on performance, efficiency, and reliability.
